Handlers convert\r\n * these to application/problem+json via toProblem(). Keeps services free of\r\n * HTTP concerns: a service throws HttpError, the route layer serializes.\r\n */\r\nexport class HttpError extends Error {\r\n  constructor(\r\n    readonly status: number,\r\n    readonly code: string,\r\n    message: string,\r\n    readonly extra?: Partial<ProblemDetails>\r\n  ) {\r\n    super(message);\r\n    this.name = 'HttpError';\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  toProblem(correlationId?: string): ProblemDetails {\r\n    return problem(this.status, this.code, this.message, undefined, {\r\n      correlationId,\r\n      ...this.extra,\r\n    });\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * SEC-INT-01 (Tester-1 live finding): class-instance identity SPLITS when the same class\r\n * is loaded through two module graphs (src via ts-jest vs dist via package main) —\r\n * 'err instanceof HttpError' is then false for a genuine HttpError and the route\r\n * boundary answers 500 where a 404 problem+json is owed. Duck-typing on the FULL\r\n * public shape (status band + contract code + toProblem projection + name) is the\r\n * cross-graph-safe discriminator; instanceof stays as the fast path.\r\n */\r\nexport function isHttpError(err: unknown): err is HttpError {\r\n  if (err instanceof HttpError) return true;\r\n  if (typeof err !== 'object' || err === null) return false;\r\n  const e = err as Partial<HttpError>;\r\n  return (\r\n    typeof e.status === 'number' &&\r\n    e.status >= 400 &&\r\n    e.status <= 599 &&\r\n    typeof e.code === 'string' &&\r\n    typeof e.toProblem === 'function' &&\r\n    (e as { name?: unknown }).name === 'HttpError'\r\n  );\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport const badRequest = (msg: string, extra?: Partial<ProblemDetails>) =>\r\n  new HttpError(400, 'INVALID_ARGUMENT', msg, extra);\r\nexport const unauthorized = (msg = 'missing or invalid api key') =>\r\n  new HttpError(401, 'UNAUTHENTICATED', msg);\r\nexport const forbidden = (msg = 'action not permitted') => new HttpError(403, 'PERMISSION_DENIED', msg);\r\nexport const notFound = (msg: string) => new HttpError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', msg);\r\nexport const conflict = (code: string, msg: string, extra?: Partial<ProblemDetails>) =>\r\n  new HttpError(409, code, msg, extra);\r\nexport const gone = (msg: string) => new HttpError(410, 'TASK_TERMINAL', msg);\r\nexport const unprocessable = (code: string, msg: string, extra?: Partial<ProblemDetails>) =>\r\n  new HttpError(422, code, msg, extra);\r\nexport const tooManyRequests = (msg: string) => new HttpError(429, 'CAPACITY', msg);\r\nexport const unavailable = (msg = 'temporarily unavailable') =>\r\n  new HttpError(503, 'TEMPORARY_UNAVAILABLE', msg);\r\n\r\n/** Zod issue list → 422 problem with JSON pointers (no secret echo). */\r\nexport function zodIssuesToProblem(\r\n  issues: { path: (string | number)[]; {"parentUuid":"ceaf45b5-d1e3-4c2a-99f2-43b6f341a819","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"342ac1c7-82c5-416a-8c78-25006e740ef0","agentId":"a0c4c25910205e35e","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01a0f974e91071b2be2437c2b05b7585","type":"tool_result","content":"import { createHmac } from 'node:crypto';\nimport { lookup as dnsLookup } from 'node:dns/promises';\nimport { createPinnedFetch } from '@du/egress';\nimport {\n  adjudicateUrlDestination,\n  isPubliclyRoutableAddress,\n  WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_HEADER,\n  WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_HEADER,\n  WEBHOOK_TIMESTAMP_HEADER,\n  webhookSigningPayload,\n  type DestinationDecision,\n  type RecipientDeliveryEnvelope,\n  type WebhookEventType,\n  type WebhookPayload,\n} from '@du/contracts';\n\n/**\n * Webhook delivery (P2-08; docs 04 WebhookDelivery + Outbox, docs 06 Webhook).\n *\n * Terminal operation transitions schedule a durable `webhook_deliveries` row\n * in the SAME transaction as the state change, so a crash between commit and\n * dispatch never loses the callback. The background dispatcher POSTs the\n * payload with an HMAC-SHA256 signature and tracks retries\n * (attempts/next_at/status). At-least-once: clients dedup by deliveryId.\n * Delivery failure never changes the operation outcome.\n */\n\n/** Minimal tx client shape shared with runtime/lifecycle (no pg import). */\nexport interface DbClient {\n  query: (sql: string, params?: unknown[]) => Promise<{ rows: Record<string, unknown>[]; rowCount: number | null }>;\n}\n\nconst TERMINAL_STATES = ['SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'TIMED_OUT'] as const;\ntype TerminalState = (typeof TERMINAL_STATES)[number];\n\nfunction eventTypeFor(state: TerminalState): WebhookEventType {\n  switch (state) {\n    case 'SUCCEEDED':\n      return 'operation.succeeded';\n    case 'FAILED':\n      return 'operation.failed';\n    case 'CANCELLED':\n      return 'operation.cancelled';\n    case 'TIMED_OUT':\n      return 'operation.timed-out';\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Schedule a webhook delivery if the operation just reached a terminal state\n * and carries a callback URL. Idempotent: the unique index on\n * (operation_id, state_version, destination_url) + ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING\n * guarantees at-most-one delivery row per terminal revision + destination,\n * even under concurrent schedulers or a replayed terminal transition.\n *\n * MUST be called inside the same transaction as the terminal UPDATE so the\n * row reflects the post-transition state_version (the terminal revision).\n */\nexport async function maybeScheduleWebhook(client: DbClient, operationId: string): Promise<void> {\n  const res = await client.query(\n    'SELECT id, tenant_id, state, state_version, callback_url, updated_at FROM operations WHERE id=$1',\n    [operationId]\n  );\n  if (!res.rowCount) return;\n  const op = res.rows[0] as {\n    id: string;\n    tenant_id: string;\n    state: string;\n    state_version: number;\n    callback_url: string | null;\n    updated_at: string;\n  };\n  if (!op.callback_url) return;\n  if (!TERMINAL_STATES.includes(op.state as TerminalState)) return;\n  const terminalState = op.state as TerminalState;\n  const payload: WebhookPayload = {\n    deliveryId: '', // placeholder replaced by the INSERT RETURNING below\n    eventType: eventTypeFor(terminalState),\n    operationId: op.id,\n    state: terminalState,\n    stateVersion: op.state_version,\n    occurredAt: new Date(op.updated_at).toISOString(),\n  };\n  // Insert first with a generated delivery_id, then stamp the payload with it\n  // in the same tx so the delivered body's deliveryId matches the durable row.\n  const inserted = await client.query(\n    `INSERT INTO webhook_deliveries\n       (operation_id, tenant_id, event_type, terminal_state, state_version, destination_url, payload)\n     VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7)\n     ON CONFLICT (operation_id, state_version, destination_url) DO NOTHING\n     RETURNING delivery_id`,\n    [op.id, op.tenant_id, payload.eventType, terminalState, op.state_version, op.callback_url, JSON.stringify(payload)]\n  );\n  if (!inserted.rowCount) return; // already scheduled for this terminal revision\n  const deliveryId = (inserted.rows[0] as { delivery_id: string }).delivery_id;\n  await client.query('UPDATE webhook_deliveries SET payload = jsonb_set(payload, \\'{deliveryId}\\', to_jsonb($2::text)) WHERE delivery_id=$1', [\n    deliveryId,\n    deliveryId,\n  ]);\n}\n\n/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */\n/* Signing                                                             */\n/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */\n\n/** HMAC-SHA256 over `{timestamp}.{body}` → `sha256=<hex>` (docs 06). */\nexport function signWebhookBody(secret: string, timestamp: string, body: string): string {\n  const hex = createHmac('sha256', secret).update(webhookSigningPayload(timestamp, body)).digest('hex');\n  return `sha256=${hex}`;\n}\n\n/** Verify a signature in constant time; returns false on any mismatch. */\nexport function verifyWebhookSignature(secret: string, timestamp: string, body: string, signature: string): boolean {\n  const expected = signWebhookBody(secret, timestamp, body);\n  const a = Buffer.from(expected);\n  const b = Buffer.from(signature);\n  if (a.length !== b.length) return false;\n  // Constant-time compare without importing node:crypto.timingSafeEqual types.\n  let diff = 0;\n  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) diff |= a[i]! ^ b[i]!;\n  return diff === 0;\n}\n\n/* The row consumes its retry budget like any\n * other failed delivery, so a fixed key or a restored registry lets the retry win.\n */\nexport const WEBHOOK_ENCRYPTION_FAILED = 'WEBHOOK_ENCRYPTION_FAILED';\n\n/**\n * The slice of the ENC-07 delivery service this module needs. Declared\n * structurally so webhooks depends on the BEHAVIOUR, not on the public-api\n * module: any object with these two members is accepted, and the production\n * `DeliveryEncryptionService` satisfies it as-is.\n */\nexport interface WebhookDeliveryEncryption {\n  resolvePolicy(tenantId: string): Promise<{ enabled: boolean } | undefined>;\n  encryptForDelivery(tenantId: string, payload: Buffer): Promise<RecipientDeliveryEnvelope>;\n}\n\n/** Never returns caller-controlled text; class only (errorNameOf pattern in server.ts). */\nfunction errorClassName(err: unknown): string {\n  if (err instanceof Error && /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,40}$/.test(err.name)) return err.name;\n  return 'Error';\n}\n\n/**\n * FIX-CR-01 destination adjudication before ANY connect. Returns the deny code, or\n * null when the destination may be dispatched. Name resolution failure is NOT a deny\n * (retryable) but a blocked answer IS (the name could point at internal space).\n */\nasync function adjudicateDestination(\n  destinationUrl: string,\n  allowHosts: ReadonlySet<string>,\n  lookupFn: (host: string) => Promise<string[]>,\n  answerCache?: Map<string, string[]>,\n): Promise<{ denied: true; code: string } | { denied: false } | { unresolved: true }> {\n  let decision: DestinationDecision;\n  try {\n    decision = adjudicateUrlDestination(destinationUrl, { allowHosts });\n  } catch {\n    return { denied: true, code: 'DESTINATION_DENIED' };\n  }\n  if (decision.kind === 'DENIED') return { denied: true, code: 'DESTINATION_DENIED' };\n  if (decision.kind === 'NEEDS_RESOLUTION' && decision.host) {\n    let answers: string[];\n    try {\n      answers = await lookupFn(decision.host);\n    } catch {\n      return { unresolved: true };\n    }\n    if (!answers.every((address) => isPubliclyRoutableAddress(address))) {\n      return { denied: true, code: 'DESTINATION_DENIED' };\n    }\n    // PR-Q3-09: hand the SAME adjudicated answers to the pinned dispatcher fetch —\n    // policy and socket share one resolution per sweep.\n    answerCache?.set(decision.host, answers);\n  }\n  return { denied: false };\n}\n\n/**\n * Deliver due pending webhooks (FIX-CR-02: durable claim BEFORE HTTP dispatch).\n *\n * Phase 1 (short tx): SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED over due rows — PENDING,\n * or DISPATCHING whose claim lease has EXPIRED (crash recovery) — then flip them\n * to DISPATCHING with a lease and COMMIT. No DB connection or row lock is held\n * during network I/O: a stalled receiver cannot pin the pool or block shutdown.\n * Phase 2 (no tx): per-row destination adjudication (FIX-CR-01: denied rows never\n * reach the network, last_error = DESTINATION_DENIED) and HTTP dispatch.\n * Phase 3 (short tx): release every claim. Issues\n\n### MEDIUM-1: So sánh bearer token không constant-time trên 3 path\n- `D:\\Git\\dugate\\du-rework\\services\\orchestrator\\src\\server.ts:2848` — `assertAdminAuth`: `if (auth !== \\`Bearer ${ctx.config.adminToken}\\`)` — plain string compare, bảo vệ toàn bộ admin mutation routes (business enable/activate/drain, connectors credentials).\n- `D:\\Git\\dugate\\du-rework\\services\\orchestrator\\src\\server.ts:1264` — usage-events ingest: `authorization !== \\`Bearer ${ctx.config.usageToken}\\``.\n- `D:\\Git\\dugate\\du-rework\\services\\orchestrator\\src\\app\\admin\\shell-router.ts:533,540` — `deriveRoleFromToken`: `presented === adminToken` / `value !== adminToken`.\n\n**Hệ quả khai thác**: timing side-channel để khôi phục adminToken từng byte. Chưa chắc khai thác được qua mạng với JIT noise, nhưng chính codebase này đã viết lý do constant-time trong `rbac.ts:49-53` (\"so the platform token cannot be recovered byte-by-byte\") và `worker-identity.ts:16-21` dùng `timingSafeEqual` — tức đây là vi phạm policy nội bộ đã tự tuyên bố, và đường `assertAdminAuth` là mặt tích cực nhất (mọi admin mutation).\n\n**Fix fail-closed**: bắt buộc mọi so sánh bearer đi qua `constantTimeEquals` của `rbac.ts:414-419` (hoặc `tokenMatches` của worker-identity). Thêm 1 test offline pin rằng không còn `!== \\`Bearer \\`` literal nào trong src.\n\n### MEDIUM-2: Không có rate limiting trên public API auth path\n- Grep toàn `src\\` chỉ tìm thấy rate limiting ở login local password (`src\\modules\\auth\\local-primitives\\login-guard.ts`), kế thừa từ middleware rate-limit của legacy DUGate nhưng **không có tương đương** cho `/api/v1/*` bằng `x-api-key`.\n- Kết hợp với `apikey.issue` chấp nhận key do admin tự chọn với tối thiểu 8 ký tự (`dispatcher.ts:548-552`), mỗi request unauthenticated đều chạm DB (sha256 + SELECT trên `api_keys`).\n\n**Hệ quả khai thác**: (a) brute-force online `x-api-key` không bị throttle — thực tế khó với key random 64-hex, nhưng khả thi với key yếu do `apikey.issue` cho phép; (b) DoS cheap: mỗi request rỗng vẫn tốn 1 query DB, amplification không giới hạn.\n\n**Fix fail-closed**: ingress-level limiter per IP + per key-prefix trả 429 trước khi chạm DB; bắt buộc entropy tối thiểu (≥ 32 ký tự random) cho `apikey.issue`; nếu không có limiter thì từ chối boot khi `NODE_ENV=production` (fail-closed at boot, cùng pattern `server.ts:425-431`).\n\n### MEDIUM-3: Header `x-api-key` dạng mảng gây 500 thay vì 401\n- `D:\\Git\\dugate\\du-rework\\services\\orchestrator\\src\\server.ts:4224` — `ctx.headers['x-api-key'] as string | undefined`; cast này sai khi client gửi 2 header trùng tên (Node truyền `string[]`).\n- `hashKey` (`server.ts:4237-4239`) gọi `createHash().update(array)` → TypeError → 500 sanitized problem. Fail-closed về mặt authorization nhưng sai mã trạng thái (500 thay vì 401) và tạo log noise — signature của một probe scanner.\n\n**Fix fail-closed**: `if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.length === 0) throw new HttpError(401, ...)` trước khi hash.\n\n### LOW (ghi nhận, không cần hành động tức thì)\n1. **Row \"dev-fallback\" key insert ở mọi boot** (`server.ts:470-477`): hash `'dev-fallback-placeholder'` không phải sha256 hex (23 ký tự, không hợp hex) nên **không có preimage** nào hash tới — không authenticate được. Rủi ro chỉ xuất hiện nếu sau này ai \"sửa\" giá trị hash này. Gợi ý: chỉ insert khi dev/test flag, giữ comment cảnh báo hiện có.\n2. **Legacy facade trả 500 cho key thiếu/sai** (`legacy-http-mount.ts:96-106,470-484`) dù comment nói \"401 in the legacy surface\" — sai doc, vẫn fail-closed, không leak. Nên thống nhất về 401 legacy shape.\n3. **`GET /api/v1/connectors/:id/test`** (`server.ts:1373-1379`): mọi key ACTIVE có thể dò reachability của connector id bất kỳ (đã sanitize, không echo upstream error) — info leak rất nhỏ, chỉ với tenant đã xác thực.\n4. **`legacy-headers.ts` canonicalization (chấp nhận `token`, `x-auth-token`, `api-key` làm credential alias) hiện KHÔNG được mount** — grep xác nhận không import vào server. Đây là trạng thái an toàn (fail-closed, chỉ `x-api-key`); lưu ý không mount nó nếu không có yêu cầu parity tương ứng.\n5. **`hasAdminBearer`** (`legacy-http-mount.ts:118-121,464`) coi MỌI bearer là admin-plane → request có bearer + key hợp lệ bỏ qua facade, xuống canonical route và vẫn bị auth đúng — chỉ là routing, không phải bypass.\n\n## 3. Kết luận\n\nAuth layer của du-rework về mặt thiết kế là fail-closed nhất quán: identity duy nhất từ `x-api-key` (hash + ACTIVE-only), mọi fence là SQL predicate, các legacy vulnerability (identity từ body, ADMIN-key fallback) được loại bỏ có chủ đích với tài liệu hướng dẫn rõ.
